findings.title: Hardcoded `* 100` overcharges JPY and KRW by 100x
findings.explanation: JPY and KRW have no minor unit (0 digits), and `src/lib/money.ts` explicitly says never to multiply or divide by 100. With `* 100`, a 1-seat annual Team plan in JPY would come out as 1800*12*0.9*100 = 1,944,000 instead of 19,440. Replace the `* 100` with `toMinorUnits(monthly * 12 * 0.9, currency)`, the same helper `monthlyPriceMinor` uses. Better still, build on `monthlyPriceMinor` so checkout and invoice share one code path.

findings.title: Floating-point arithmetic on money and rounding applied only at the end
findings.explanation: `monthly * 12 * 0.9` uses binary floats (0.9 is not exact), so results can land on rounding boundaries, for example x.5 cases. Compute the discount in integer minor units, e.g. `Math.round(monthlyMinor * 12 * 9 / 10)`, or define the rounding rule explicitly. Pick one rounding rule so checkout and invoice always agree.

findings.title: Magic numbers for the discount and months
findings.explanation: 12 and 0.9 are inline literals. Extract named constants such as `ANNUAL_MONTHS = 12` and `ANNUAL_DISCOUNT = 0.10`, so the discount can be changed in one place and is easy to find.

findings.title: No tests for the new function
findings.explanation: There are no tests. Add cases for USD/EUR (2 digits), JPY/KRW (0 digits), and a seat count greater than 1. A JPY case would have caught the 100x bug. Also consider validating `seats` (an integer of at least 1).

prompt:
Review this pull request.

## Add annual plan pricing

Annual billing launches next month: twelve months for the price of 10.8 (a 10% discount). Adds `annualPriceMinor` next to the monthly price so the checkout page and the invoice generator compute it the same way.

## Diff

```diff
diff --git a/src/services/pricing.ts b/src/services/pricing.ts
index 142a18d..f738804 100644
--- a/src/services/pricing.ts
+++ b/src/services/pricing.ts
@@ -16,3 +16,9 @@ export function monthlyPriceMinor(plan: Plan, currency: Currency, seats: number)
 export function planLabel(plan: Plan): string {
   return plan === 'team' ? 'Team' : 'Business'
 }
+
+// Annual billing: twelve months with a 10% discount, in minor units for the invoice.
+export function annualPriceMinor(plan: Plan, currency: Currency, seats: number): number {
+  const monthly = PLANS[plan].monthly[currency] * seats
+  return Math.round(monthly * 12 * 0.9 * 100)
+}
```
